mapper.insert: insert into basket_discipline_execution_detail (discipline_record_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, execution_status, result_message, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{disciplineRecordId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{executionStatus}, #{resultMessage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.update: update basket_discipline_execution_detail set execution_status = #{executionStatus}, result_message = #{resultMessage}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select id, discipline_record_id as disciplineRecordId, action_type as actionType, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, execution_status as executionStatus, result_message as resultMessage, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_discipline_execution_detail where discipline_record_id = #{disciplineRecordId} and is_delete = 0 order by id
